title: AI-Designed Viruses Explored in Roundtable Discussion
excerpt: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used generative AI to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses.
body_html:
A recent roundtable discussion explores the intersection of artificial intelligence and biological design, featuring Stanford University PhD student Samuel King. In 2025, King utilized a generative AI model to propose preliminary genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses.

While this development does not yet represent fully AI-generated life forms, experts note that such an achievement could potentially be the next step in this area of research.
